2, following the British educational system. CGS is an associate member of the Round Square Organization, emphasizing the development of international understanding and responsibility among students. citeturn0search1

The school operates multiple campuses:

- **Upper School**: Located at 321/11 Sarson Road, Chittagong.

- **Middle School**: Situated at 321/11 Sarson Road, Chittagong.

- **Lower School**: Also at 321/11 Sarson Road, Chittagong.

- **CGS Dhaka**: Located in the Gulshan area of Dhaka. citeturn0search1

CGS offers a range of extracurricular activities, including sports, arts, and community service, fostering holistic development. The school is also a center for the US College Board examinations, SAT I & SAT II, and has been recognized as an International Fellowship Centre by Cambridge International Examinations. citeturn0search1
